note: Items this remediation pass cannot close from inside the repository. Each names what would unblock it. The production exit gate (tools/release_gate.py) refuses GO while any is open.

blockers.title: Human owners and approvals
blockers.needs: Owner confirms accountable owner, names a backup owner, security/release/incident/policy approvers, and approves ADR-0001, SLO thresholds, operational commitments.

blockers.title: Repository licence
blockers.needs: Owner chooses the licence; LICENSE full text added.

blockers.title: Approved release-signing identity
blockers.needs: Sigstore/GPG/KMS signing identity and trust root; replaces the development HMAC signature in dist/RELEASE_MANIFEST.json.

blockers.title: Key management / transport
blockers.needs: KMS/HSM for config-signing, audit-sealing and transport keys; external append-only audit anchor; TLS termination for collectors.

blockers.title: Production identity mechanisms
blockers.needs: Owner names trust anchors and mechanisms (OIDC/JWT issuer, SPIFFE/mTLS, attestation) per profile; adapters written against IdentityAdapter.

blockers.title: Hostile-code isolation runtime
blockers.needs: Network/filesystem namespaces + seccomp (Linux), AppContainer/job objects (Windows), or a pinned Wasm/microVM runtime.

blockers.title: pk_core / sibling-layer estate baseline
blockers.needs: Authoritative pk_core package pinned by commit/digest plus sibling INV-30/42/44 and PLN-07 fixtures.

blockers.title: Multi-runtime CI matrix
blockers.needs: CI runners for Windows, macOS and aarch64 (workflow provided, never executed). CPython 3.10/3.11/3.12/3.13 on Linux x86_64 were available and certified in this pass.

blockers.title: Release-tier soak
blockers.needs: Scheduled 4 h+ run of tools/scale_soak.py --tier release on the reference host.

blockers.title: Fleet / distributed tests
blockers.needs: A multi-node deployment of the bridge/service mode (none exists).

blockers.title: Deployment telemetry & canary
blockers.needs: Real metrics/log/trace backends, alert routing, a canary population and observation window.

blockers.title: Edge power/thermal
blockers.needs: Access to a representative far-edge device with power measurement.
